jobs.title: Salesforce Developer
jobs.description: About the Role** We are seeking a Salesforce CRM Developer to design, develop, implement, and maintain scalable solutions across the Salesforce CRM platform. The role focuses on Salesforce application development, API integrations, customer data management, consent and email verification workflows, business process automation, and production support. The successful candidate will collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, business stakeholders, QA teams, integration teams, and external application teams to translate business requirements into secure, reliable, and maintainable technical solutions. **Job Title** Salesforce CRM Developer. **Responsibilities** - Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex Classes, Triggers, Batch Apex, Scheduled Apex, SOQL, Lightning Components, and Salesforce automation capabilities. - Implement business logic, validation rules, exception handling, and reusable components using established Salesforce development patterns. - Develop scheduled and batch processes for data processing, record management, data cleanup, and business automation. - Manage and support Salesforce data models involving Contacts, Users, Accounts, Campaigns, Campaign Members, and Account Affiliations. - Perform technical analysis and contribute to solution design for new Salesforce capabilities and enhancements. - Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with Salesforce development best practices. - Investigate and resolve production issues, data inconsistencies, automation failures, and access-related problems. - Design, develop, test, and maintain integrations between Salesforce and internal or external applications. - Develop and support REST and SOAP APIs for secure data exchange. - Work with JSON payloads, authentication mechanisms, API contracts, and integration error handling. - Troubleshoot API requests and responses using debugging tools and logs. - Coordinate with external application and integration teams to validate API contracts, payload structures, data mappings, authentication requirements, error scenarios, and integration dependencies. - Implement appropriate logging, exception handling, monitoring, and retry mechanisms to improve integration reliability. - Support end-to-end integration testing and production issue resolution. - Develop and support customer data management processes within Salesforce. - Implement solutions to manage and synchronize customer profiles, consent, subscription preferences, and email verification information. - Support business rules related to customer opt-in and opt-out preferences and communication eligibility. - Ensure appropriate validation and processing of customer consent and email verification status. - Identify and resolve data quality or synchronization issues impacting downstream applications and customer processes. - Work with business and technical stakeholders to ensure customer data workflows meet defined business and compliance requirements. - Investigate and resolve Salesforce production incidents and application defects. **Required Skills** - Strong hands-on experience in Salesforce CRM development. - Proficiency in Apex, Triggers, Batch Apex, Scheduled Apex, SOQL, and Lightning Components. - Experience with Salesforce automation tools and business process implementation. - Strong understanding of Salesforce data models and object relationships. - Experience in REST and SOAP API development and integration. - Knowledge of JSON, authentication mechanisms, API contracts, and error handling. - Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills. - Experience in production support and issue resolution. - Ability to work with cross-functional teams and translate business requirements into technical solutions. - Strong understanding of secure, scalable, and maintainable development practices. **Desirable Skills** - Experience with customer consent management and email verification workflows. - Familiarity with data synchronization and data quality management. - Experience with logging, monitoring, and retry mechanisms for integrations. - Exposure to integration testing and release support. - Knowledge of Salesforce best practices for performance optimization and governor limits. - Experience working in agile delivery environments. 5-10 Yrs Sales, Cpq, Salesforce Sales Cloud, Sales force development, Salesforce, Salesforce Lightning, Lightning, CRM

jobs.title: Automation Test Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary We are looking for a skilled and passionate Automation Test Engineer with 3-5 years of experience in test automation, API testing, and quality engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building and maintaining scalable automation frameworks, improving test coverage, ensuring high-quality software releases, and driving automation initiatives across UI, API, and performance testing domains. The candidate should possess strong expertise in Playwright, TypeScript, Cucumber BDD, API Automation, Jenkins, GitLab, and JMeter, along with a quality-first mindset and a proactive approach to continuous improvement. Requirements Design, develop, and maintain scalable UI automation frameworks and test scripts using Playwright, TypeScript, and Cucumber BDD to ensure reliable and maintainable test coverage. Design and implement CI/CD automation pipelines in Jenkins, integrating UI and API automation suites to enable continuous testing and faster feedback during releases. Develop, maintain, and execute API automation test suites to validate functionality, integrations, data integrity, and overall system reliability. Utilize GitLab for source control management, code reviews, and adherence to established branching and release management strategies. Leverage GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted tools/agents to improve automation development efficiency, script quality, and test coverage. Perform sanity, functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing to validate application quality across releases and environments. Create, review, and maintain test cases, test scenarios, test data, and test documentation, ensuring complete coverage of business, functional, and non-functional requirements. Create and maintain test datasets required for testing activities and implement dynamic test data generation approaches within automation frameworks to reduce maintenance effort and improve script reliability. Monitor daily automation executions, analyse test reports, investigate failures, identify defects or script issues, and track them through resolution and closure. Participate in automation script reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards, framework guidelines, and test automation best practices. Identify flaky automation scripts, perform root cause analysis, and implement improvements to enhance automation reliability and stability. Analyse defects and production issues and add corresponding scenarios to the regression suite to minimize defect leakage and improve overall product quality. Track automation coverage, execution trends, and quality metrics, and provide recommendations to improve automation effectiveness and test efficiency. Design, develop, and execute performance test scripts using JMeter, analyse performance reports, identify bottlenecks, and provide recommendations for system optimization. Write and execute SQL queries to validate backend data, verify data integrity across systems, and support functional, API, and end-to-end testing activities. Required Technical Skills Playwright with TypeScript Cucumber BDD Framework API Testing & Automation Postman Jenkins GitLab CI/CD Pipeline Implementation Performance Testing using Apache JMeter GitHub Copilot and AI Agent Development/Usage Jira, TestRail or similar Test Management Tools Automation Framework Design and Development 4-7 Yrs Jenkins, Automation, Software testing, Typescript, UI, JMeter, API Automation, UI Automation

Ensure finishing activities are completed as per project schedules and established quality benchmarks. B. Raise and monitor quality observations and ensure timely corrective action and closure. Identify finishing defects, prevent rework, and maintain consistent quality across floors and residential units. Ensure proper documentation of inspections, test reports, checklists, and quality records. C. Planning and Progress Monitoring Monitor daily and weekly finishing progress against project schedules and milestones. Coordinate with the Planning team to identify delays, assess constraints, and implement corrective measures. Ensure the availability of manpower, materials, tools, and equipment required for planned activities. Maintain daily progress reports, inspection records, and relevant site documentation. Escalate critical execution issues and potential delays to the Project Manager or Construction Manager. D. Contractor and Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate and monitor contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and site workforce to ensure compliance with agreed scope, quality, and timelines. Participate in site coordination meetings and follow up on pending activities and action points. Ensure appropriate material planning, handling, storage, and utilization at the site. E. Snagging, Safety and Handover Coordinate pre-handover inspections, snagging, de-snagging, and closure of outstanding finishing works. Ensure completed units meet approved quality requirements and are ready for client inspection and handover. Maintain finishing-related documentation and support project handover activities. Ensure compliance with site safety procedures during finishing operations. Promote safe working practices and report unsafe conditions to the concerned team. 3. Mandatory Eligibility Criteria Qualification: BE/B.Tech/Diploma in Civil Engineering. Experience: 6–12 years of relevant experience in civil construction and finishing execution. MIVAN Experience: Mandatory experience in high-rise residential projects constructed using MIVAN/aluminium formwork. Project Scale: Experience handling finishing activities in residential projects of G+20 floors and above. Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of finishing materials, execution methodologies, drawings, specifications, and site coordination. Quality Management: Practical knowledge of finishing inspections, quality checklists, defect rectification, and snag closure. Contractor Management: Experience coordinating contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and site workforce. Planning and Coordination: Ability to monitor progress, coordinate resources, and achieve finishing milestones. Communication: Good coordination, reporting, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills. 4. Preferred Experience Previous experience in a PMC or client-side project execution environment. Exposure to large-scale or premium high-rise residential developments. Experience coordinating with MEP, QA/QC, Planning, and project management teams. Working knowledge of MS Project, Primavera P6, or equivalent project scheduling tools. Experience in waterproofing execution, faade works, and finishing quality inspections. Familiarity with construction practices and project execution requirements in Bangalore. 5. Key Performance Expectations The selected candidate will be expected to: Achieve finishing milestones in line with approved project schedules. Maintain consistent workmanship and finishing quality across floors and residential units. Ensure timely closure of quality observations and finishing defects. Coordinate effectively with contractors and cross-functional project teams. Minimize rework, material wastage, and execution delays. Maintain accurate progress reports and quality documentation. Support timely snag closure, client inspections, and project handover. Ensure compliance with site safety and approved construction procedures. 6. Reporting and Coordination Reports to: Project Manager / Construction Manager Coordinates with: QA/QC Team, Planning Team, MEP Team, Site Engineers, Contractors, Subcontractors, Vendors, and Client Representatives. 7. Candidate Screening Guidelines Candidates should clearly mention the following in their CV: Names and locations of high-rise residential projects handled. Total experience and relevant finishing execution experience. Specific experience in MIVAN/aluminium formwork projects. Project height or scale, including the number of floors handled. Types of finishing activities supervised. Experience in contractor management, quality inspections, and snag closure. Previous organisation type: PMC, developer, or construction contractor. Screening Note: Only candidates with proven high-rise residential MIVAN finishing execution experience in projects of G+20 floors and above will be considered. Candidates with experience exclusively in low-rise buildings, commercial projects, or high-rise projects without relevant MIVAN finishing exposure will not be shortlisted. Designation Note: The final designation will be aligned with the candidate’s experience, technical capabilities, and internal evaluation, wherever applicable. 6-10 Yrs Mivan, Flooring, High Rise, Finishing Work, Formwork, Tiles, Finishing, Aluminium

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The Application Modernization Platform (AMP) team is dedicated to solving one of the industry's biggest challenges: transforming rigid, legacy applications that suffer from poor scalability and high operating costs into modern, microservices-based architectures on MongoDB. An important aspect of this is Data Migration. MongoDB is building a world-class team in India to build tooling that helps customers migrate their data from legacy relational databases to MongoDB in real-time. As companies modernise their application and data ecosystems, they are increasingly drawn to the flexibility and scalability of the document model. The tools developed by the Data Migration team are critical in this journey, helping customers with schema modeling, initial data loads, and continuous data synchronization. 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer with experience in the Java ecosystem, streaming systems, and data-intensive applications to join our team. We are building a sophisticated data migration suite using a modern technology stack, which includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Debezium, and React. A successful candidate will be a key contributor to our backend services, collaborating closely with product management and other engineers to design and implement cutting-edge products that solve complex customer challenges. 
 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurgaon for our hybrid working model. 
 The ideal candidate for this role will have 
 
 6+ years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem 
 Solid experience in software architecture and development 
 Extensive experience with streaming data platforms such as Apache Kafka and Change Data Capture (CDC) tools like Debezium 
 Extensive experience with relational and document data modeling and hands-on experience with at least one SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, etc) and at least one document database (e.g. MongoDB) 
 Exposure to client-side technologies such as JavaScript and React is a plus 
 Good understanding of algorithms, data structures and their time and space complexity 
 Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and contribute to the overall technical direction and roadmap of the team 
 Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
 
 Position Expectations 
 
 Contribute high-quality, well-tested code to the modernization and framework team and its surrounding services 
 Collaborate effectively with Product Management, other engineers, and designers to build and deliver on the product roadmap 
 Participate actively in code reviews to enforce best practices and patterns 
 Help troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in our distributed systems 
 Give and solicit feedback on technical design documents and pull requests 
 Perform tasks related to process such as CI/CD, quality, testing, etc 
 
 Success Measures 
 Within the first three months, you will have 
 
 Familiarize yourself with the MongoDB Modernization Infrastructure Frameworks stack 
 Set up software development infrastructure (tech stack, build tools, etc) to enable development using the relevant tech stacks 
 Started collaborating with your peers and contributed to code reviews and design reviews 
 
 Within six months, you will have 
 
 Familiarised yourself with the rest of our the application modernization tool stack 
 Delivered at least one large scale feature that spans the entire tech stack 
 Reviewed and contributed to scope and technical design documents 
 
 Within 12 months, you will have 
 
 Become a key contributor to our stack, capable of taking on complex features independently 
 Helped recruit and interview new members of the team 
 Collaborated effectively with other teams at MongoDB on cross-functional projects 
 
 About MongoDB 
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 
 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software. 
 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB. 
 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world! 
 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 
 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.title: Analytics and AI Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role: This role sits at the intersection of business, analytics and applied AI. You'll work directly with business teams across sales, supply chain, finance, commercial and marketing diagnosing problems, designing systems and shipping solutions that real teams depend on. You own problems end to end: from understanding the business rules to writing the code, deploying it, monitoring it and documenting it so others can build on it. You'll join the AI and Analytics team. where everyone works across the full problem, understanding the business context, shaping the approach, writing the code and running it in production. A large part of the job is translating vague business requests into precise specifications and explaining trade-offs and failures to non-technical stakeholders without jargon. What You'll Do: Automations that replace recurring manual workflows, from trigger through approval to delivery. A knowledge and retrieval layer over supply chain, commercial and consumer data, with grounded and cited outputs. The shared services these run on - deployment, monitoring, data access and validation. Build end-to-end automations that replace manual workflows - from trigger to delivery, with approval steps where needed. Build LLM agents and RAG systems over structured and unstructured data, with grounded and cited outputs. Write production SQL and Python to extract, transform and reconcile data - every output validated before it reaches a stakeholder. Deploy and maintain services on GCP with logging and alerting in place. Translate business rules into documented code that non-engineers can verify and sign off. What we're looking for: Python - Production-grade Python: scheduled services, background workers, data pipelines and API integrations. Config-driven, tested and reliable. Not notebooks. SQL and BigQuery - Strong SQL for transformations, modelling and reconciliation at scale. Declares grain before joining, validates outputs against source. LLM engineering - Has shipped LLM applications to real users with tool calling and structured outputs. Treats prompts as code -versioned and tested against labelled samples. Accuracy measured before and after every change, not assumed. RAG and knowledge systems - Has built RAG systems in production: ingestion pipelines, embeddings, vector databases and hybrid search. Evaluates retrieval quality on a held-out set. Cloud and deployment - Has owned and operated services on GCP end to end. Responsible for production uptime, not just deployment. Data validation and testing - Writes automated checks for every pipeline: row counts, source reconciliation, freshness and edge cases. A system is not done until it can detect its own failures. Good to have Agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI) or MCP servers. Event-driven and webhook integration patterns at production scale. Semantic layer or metrics catalog (dbt, LookML, Unity Catalog). Tech product or FMCG / consumer industry background. System integration connecting AI outputs into existing tools and business systems (ERP, CRM, BI dashboards, internal platforms). Can read a data scientist's notebook, understand the logic and convert it into a production service. 3-5 Yrs Python, API Integration, Crewai, Artificial Intelligence, AI Engineer, LLM, Analytics, Unity Catalog
